nodes.text:
1/ 📈 WWSCAN Weekly Data

Respiratory weekly update: All respiratory viruses we monitor (SARS-CoV-2, RSV, Influenza A, Influenza B, HMPV and EV-D68) are in the ‘Low’ category nationwide. https://t.co/jU3icmTCfW

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 2/ COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the ‘Low’ category with low concentrations and no significant trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/unRClqZiwj

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 3/ COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites, LP.8.1 variant (a descendant of KP.1) in brown (35.8%), NB.1.8.1 in mauve (13.1%), & XFG in orange (10.3%) make up around 59% of variants. Note sequencing data has longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. https://t.co/uD1XdkY0zf

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 4/ Influenza: Nationally, Flu A and Flu B are in the ‘Low’ category and not in seasonal onset. About 9% and 14% of sites are in seasonal onset for Flu A and Flu B, respectively. https://t.co/LAhFcloMWc

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 5/ H5 influenza marker: H5 has been detected in 28 states since monitoring began - 6 in the West, 7 in the Midwest, 9 in the South, and 6 in the Northeast. As of 6/11/25, 17 states have also reported infected cattle herds. Recent wastewater detection has been in NJ & VA. https://t.co/Yo1pL5uBEx

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 6/ RSV: RSV is in the ‘Low’ category nationally and not in seasonal onset. About 1% of sites are still in seasonal onset for RSV. https://t.co/J74ia82bc4

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 7/ HMPV: HMPV is in the ‘Low’ category nationally because it is not in onset. 42% of sites are now in seasonal onset for HMPV, which is near the national onset threshold. https://t.co/pWXTgTBZak

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 8/ Norovirus is in the ‘Medium’ category nationally with medium concentrations and no significant trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/UyrvQSH8eK
